description: Historical baseline of two distinct probing channels. DREAM's 'pixel is real' claim predicts structure resolution flattens at λ_q while field detection goes deeper but finds no structure — only 'shadows' (field fluctuations). The gap between the two channels IS the pixel: the regime where fields exist but structure doesn't. DREAM does NOT predict a specific value for λ_q — it is treated as a measured constant (axiom A4), not a derived one.

baseline_records.technique: LIGO quantum noise — mirror displacement by vacuum fluctuations (40 kg mirrors moved by 10⁻²⁰ m)
baseline_records.source: Yu et al. (2020) Nature — quantum correlations between light and kilogram-mass mirrors

baseline_records.technique: AGIS atom interferometer (projected displacement sensitivity 10⁻¹⁹ m)
baseline_records.source: Dimopoulos et al. (2008) PRL — gravitational wave detection via atom interferometry
User-reported: current toolkits offering clear resolution of structures and interference at ~10⁻¹⁴ m

channel_descriptions.structure: Structure resolution — the smallest scale at which spatial features can be resolved (optical/electron microscopy, interferometry with imaging). This is the DREAM 'pixel' channel: beyond this scale, no structure is found.
channel_descriptions.field: Field detection — the smallest scale at which field effects (quantum fluctuations, gravitational fields, vacuum noise) can be detected WITHOUT resolving structure. These are the 'shadows': field fluctuations at 10⁻¹⁸ to 10⁻²⁰ m where no structure has ever been found.

dream_prediction.claim: λ_q is a structural cutoff of the projection kernel — no engineering improvement can push it lower. The pixel is real.
dream_prediction.no_specific_value: DREAM does NOT predict a numerical value for λ_q. It is a measured constant of our kernel slice (axiom A4), not a derived one.
dream_prediction.two_channel_prediction: Structure resolution curve flattens (saturates) at λ_q. Field detection goes deeper (10⁻¹⁸ to 10⁻²⁰ m) but finds no structure — only field fluctuations ('shadows'). The gap between structure resolution and field detection IS the pixel. If structure resolution keeps dropping indefinitely with engineering → DREAM falsified. If it flattens while field detection goes deeper → DREAM supported: beyond the pixel, only fields.
dream_prediction.current_status: Structure resolution at ~10⁻¹⁰ to 10⁻¹⁴ m. Field detection at ~10⁻¹⁸ to 10⁻²⁰ m. Gap of 4-6 orders of magnitude — fields detected well below where structure can be resolved. Consistent with DREAM prediction.
